intro.uz: Kamola akasining toʻyi haqida hikoya qiladi. Oʻqishdan oldin oʻylab koʻring: siz oxirgi marta qachon toʻyda boʻlgansiz?

paragraphs.en: My name is Kamola. Last summer, my older brother Sardor got married. In Uzbekistan, a wedding is a big event for the whole family. We started to prepare two months before the day. My parents invited more than three hundred guests!
paragraphs.uz: Mening ismim Kamola. Oʻtgan yozda akam Sardor uylandi. Oʻzbekistonda toʻy butun oila uchun katta voqea. Biz toʻydan ikki oy oldin tayyorgarlik koʻrishni boshladik. Ota-onam uch yuzdan ortiq mehmon taklif qildi!

paragraphs.en: My mother and my aunts were very busy. They cleaned the house, bought new dishes and made a lot of sweets. My father and his friends found a big restaurant for the party. Everybody helped, even my little cousins.
paragraphs.uz: Onam va xolalarim juda band edi. Ular uyni tozalashdi, yangi idishlar sotib olishdi va juda koʻp shirinlik tayyorlashdi. Otam va uning doʻstlari bazm uchun katta restoran topishdi. Hamma yordam berdi, hatto kichkina amakivachchalarim ham.

paragraphs.en: On the morning of the wedding, there was a special plov called nahor oshi. Many men from our neighbourhood came to it. They ate plov early in the morning and gave their good wishes to my brother.
paragraphs.uz: Toʻy kuni ertalab nahor oshi deb ataladigan maxsus osh boʻldi. Unga mahallamizdan koʻplab erkaklar keldi. Ular erta tongda osh yeyishdi va akamga ezgu tilaklarini bildirishdi.

paragraphs.en: In the evening, the main party started at the restaurant. The bride wore a beautiful white dress. There was live music, and everybody danced for hours. The tables were full of fruit, salads and delicious food.
paragraphs.uz: Kechqurun asosiy bazm restoranda boshlandi. Kelin chiroyli oq libos kiygan edi. Jonli musiqa yangradi, hamma soatlab raqsga tushdi. Dasturxonlar meva, salatlar va mazali taomlarga toʻla edi.

paragraphs.en: It was a long and tiring day, but I was very happy. Now I have a sister-in-law, and our family is bigger!
paragraphs.uz: Bu uzoq va charchatadigan kun boʻldi, lekin men juda xursand edim. Endi mening kelinoyim bor, oilamiz esa kattaroq boʻldi!
